_comment: Narrative-driven celluloid film grain profiles and mathematical parameters for organic texture synthesis. Follows Hollywood Colorist and Film Craft Chemist rules: midtone luminance masking, monochromatic silver halide (0% chroma noise), temporal randomness, post-grade/pre-sharpening ordering.

luminance_masking.description: Grain lives in midtones (~18-70% luma); suppressed in blacks (<15%) and whites (>85%).

monochromatic_base.description: 0% color noise. Silver halide crystals are structural texture, not RGB rainbow noise.

temporal_randomness.description: Noise animates frame-to-frame matching sequence fps (23.976/24/30 CFR).

execution_pro_tips.pipeline_order: Input -> Color Grade / Look LUT -> Film Grain -> Master Sharpening -> Render

profile_a_clean_modern_cinema.narrative_context: High-end commercial, corporate, sleek modern drama, thriller, sci-fi. Adds tactile depth to digital sensors without looking retro.

profile_b_classic_hollywood.narrative_context: Character-driven pieces, indie films, period dramas, human interest stories, music videos. Warm, nostalgic, deeply human.

profile_c_gritty_documentarian.narrative_context: Gritty flashbacks, raw sports documentaries, war films, urban street style, intense investigative drama. Immediate, low-budget, real.
